exactCause.task: RepositoryTask currently carries requirement, clone and optional tests; CLI supplies tests=None unconditionally.
exactCause.execution: WorkspaceProtocol::execute filters all structural steps then executes clone/locate/read/edit/verify unconditionally. A repository question or explicit Run request reaches edit after actual location succeeds. edit::derive_change returns no change, so the observed open reason is now honest rather than echoed task.
exactCause.presentation: rust/src/main.rs Command::Solve prints outcome.diff and open diagnostics only. SolveOutcome has no observed answer/report field.
exactCause.harnessQuality: run_coding_ladder.sh answered currently searches combined stdout/stderr for expected_answer; old echoed unresolved task accidentally satisfied it. Do not restore echo or relax floor.

reuseProposal.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED; proposed general mechanism, native CI required
reuseProposal.classification: Choose typed read/query/Run/mutation obligations from existing seeded role and planner contracts before selecting structural protocol steps. Keep task and complete obligation ledger; unsupported/ambiguous requests remain honest gaps.
reuseProposal.query: Resolve actual repository manifest test target/module hierarchy and read observed bounded Cargo/source paths; render actual owned paths with source identities. Reuse RepositoryWorkspace::source_files/read and locate::locate_targets; never hardcode repository-specific tests path or answer.
reuseProposal.run: Bind actual requested command to exact current workspace/root/source head, reuse repository_workspace::verify::RunCommand and run_named_tests / existing allows and deadlines. Explicit cargo check is already in canonical allowlist. No arbitrary command opt-in, timeout increase or empty-workspace driver.
reuseProposal.driverBoundary: run_agentic_task_in creates a new EMPTY AgentWorkspace; calling it with base_dir alone does not make the selected repository available. Any reuse needs an explicit already-owned existing workspace entrypoint or read/run adapter over RepositoryWorkspace, preserving workspace restrictions.
reuseProposal.stdout: Add a separately typed observed report/answer surface alongside diff/open; only publish actual source-backed query result or complete command receipt/status/timeout. Persist task/source/run/command bindings in evidence and whole output, never request echo as completion.

meaningfulValidationRequired: Two unchanged original prompts on tiny real Cargo repository: query resolves actual manifest target path; Run reports actual command exit/stdout from exact root.
Heldout different test target path/profile proves no hardcoded test directory answer.
Explicit command nonzero, missing interpreter/toolchain, timeout, wrong cwd/source head remain unsuccessful with original evidence.
Knowledge and command actions do not mutate/stage/commit; existing mutation protocol and all original attribution assertions retained.
Original 130 cases/floor23 preserved; no effect/read receipt is inferred from stdout word matching.
